_comment: Centralized parameter location across entirety of model. Hardcoded fallbacks are in the individual modules.

assignment._comment: SA seams for the Script 1/4 flow model (road_revised.py). All default-neutral: capacity_scale/breakpoint_scale/congestion_scale multiply per-tier profile values (1.0 = historical), speed_shift_mph shifts free-flow speeds additively (0.0 = historical; floored at per-tier min speed), effective_hours_per_day is the daily capacity/flow divisor (24 = historical).

cost_time._comment: avg_vehicle_occupancy_car 1.52 is NHTS 2022 Table 5-2's average all-purpose vehicle occupancy (persons per vehicle trip), replacing the audit's provisional 1.67 all-purpose figure -- 1.67 was flagged by the audit itself as a known value-level issue pending a sourced replacement; 1.52 is that replacement, not the commute-only figure (~1.18). isolation_usd_per_day monetizes isolated trips in Script 4 (freight monetization is a flagged open research question; default mirrors Script 5's ISOLATION_UNIT_COST_USD).

cost_operating._comment_tables: use_table_* flags (default false = current formula behavior) switch road_revised.compute_costs_for_links to linear interpolation of the discretized parameters/tables CSVs; *_table names select UK-current vs US-candidate files (US candidates carry APPROXIMATE_VERIFY status).

preprocess._comment_bridge_index: nbi_bridge_index_path points at the output of scripts/build_nbi_bridge_index.py (e_id -> road_bridge/deck_width_m). null = no index configured yet; faf5_network.py falls back to road_bridge='no' for every link with a loud warning, never silently.

hazard_disruption._comment: speed_depth_exponent is p in V = V_max*(1 - d/d_c)**p (fragility/flood_operational.py); p=2 reproduces the historical Pregnolato quadratic, p=1 the linear alternate.

vulnerability._comment: SA seams for Script 3 vulnerability curves. curve_theta (0..1, null = off) blends each low/high-flow damage-curve pair d=(1-theta)*d_low+theta*d_high; depth_scale_lambda (0.8..1.25, null = off) evaluates curves at depth/lambda (damage-onset shift); damage_threshold_scale multiplies every categorical depth threshold in fragility/flood_categorical.py (1.0 = historical).

damage_costs._comment: Unit-cost scales applied in Script 3 AFTER the pristine damage_cost workbook loads (the workbook is never edited). 1.0 = historical.

recovery._comment: Script 4 residual-floodwater depth gates (m): day-2 speed constraint applies to links with intermediate <= depth < deep, day-3 to depth >= deep. Historical literals 2 m / 6 m. Scale both coherently with one Morris factor via `_scales: recovery.residual_depth_gates_m`.
